blocks.text: Team preview of the Detroit Pistons ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last NBA season: 60-22, lost to Cleveland in the second round. Coach: J.B. Bickerstaff (3rd season with Pistons, 10th season overall 359-350). Season opener: Oct. 20 vs. Boston. Departures: F Tobias Harris, C Isaiah Stewart, G Caris LeVert. Additions: F John Collins, G Isaiah Joe, F Taurean Prince, G Ebuka Okori. What to expect The Pistons are favored to repeat as Central Division champions, but they’re behind Philadelphia, the New York Knicks and Boston in odds to win the East a season after winning a conference-high 60 games.
